text:
Tara Nguyen: Heads up — planning FlashAttn v3 integration canary next Tue. Need alignment on kernel selection logic, feature flags, and KV cache smoke tests. Short agenda: 1) telemetry/fflag knobs 2) batching heuristics checks 3) KV cache regen/eviction profiling 4) rollback plan.
Mike Patel: SG. telemetry first: add sampled logs for kernel_choice, batch_size, kv_hit/evict. Keep overhead <1% ideally.
Jiang Li: we have /telemetry/kernel_choice sampled at 1%, can bump to 10% for the canary window. Willing to run 10% for 1 hr.
Olga Sokolova: +1 but last time 10% bumped p99 by ~12% due to serialization. We should use async ship or compress payload.
Sam Ortiz: I dug into perf runs — paste:
```
# perf summary on 2k reqs
flashv2: avg=12.3ms p95=28.7ms p99=62.1ms
flashv3: avg=10.1ms p95=24.2ms p99=58.9ms
paged-attn cold: avg=14.8ms p99=95ms
KV-hit path: 6.5ms avg
KV-regen spike on first token: +40ms
```
Sam Ortiz: v3 helps avg but paged attention cold starts show big spike on first regen; we need to prewarm KV or throttle initial bursts.
Ravi Menon: For batching heuristics — can we tighten max_batch_size for paged-attn models to 8? Current default 32 causes memory thrash.
Mike Patel: yes, we can gate in kernel_chooser: if model.is_paged => max_batch=8, else 32. Add fflag `kernels.paged_v3_small_batch`.
Tara Nguyen: Good. Also need rollout flags: `kernels.flashv3_enabled` (off by default), `kernels.flashv3_canary` (on for 5% traffic), `kernels.paged_v3_small_batch` (off by default).
Olga Sokolova: QA note — add end-to-end eval prompts for long context (~16k) to catch paged-attn regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary cluster (canary-3) provisioned in us-west-2. ID: cluster-zz12. Apply flags: kernels.flashv3_canary=on(5%) at 3681234700.
Jiang Li: I'll increase sampling to 10% at canary start and stream to perf-dashboard. Ping me when deployed.
Sam Ortiz: Action: I'll run KV prewarm job in canary (script `scripts/kv_preheat.sh --warm-keys=1000`) before traffic ramps.
Ravi Menon: I'll open a quick PR to kernel_chooser with the paged batch cap and fflag checks. Target deploying today EOD.
Tara Nguyen: Ok owners: Jiang (telemetry), Sam (prewarm/runbook), Ravi (kernel fflag PR), Mike (rollout ops). Meet Thu 10am to review perf dashboards. :thumbsup: 
qa-bot: Running smoke test suite (smoke/attn-paged) once flags are applied — will post results here.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks all — let's keep thread for rollout notes and any perf regressions.
